mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, merchant_name_snapshot, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, request_id, broadcast_date, daily_slot, filter_json, content, status, audience_count, consented_count, no_consent_count, frequency_skipped_count, delivered_count, failed_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_broadcast where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_crm_broadcast (merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, merchant_name_snapshot, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, request_id, broadcast_date, daily_slot, filter_json, content, status, audience_count, consented_count, no_consent_count, frequency_skipped_count, delivered_count, failed_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{merchantOwnerMemberId}, #{merchantNameSnapshot}, #{actorMemberId}, #{actorRoleCode}, #{requestId}, current_date, #{dailySlot}, #{filterJson}, #{content}, 'SENDING', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from merchant_crm_broadcast where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and broadcast_date = current_date
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_crm_broadcast_recipient (broadcast_id, merchant_id, member_id, customer_name_snapshot, consent_event_id_snapshot, status, attempt_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{broadcastId}, #{merchantId}, #{memberId}, #{customerNameSnapshot}, #{consentEventIdSnapshot}, 'PENDING', 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, broadcast_id, merchant_id, member_id, customer_name_snapshot, consent_event_id_snapshot, status, failure_code, failure_message, message_receipt_id, attempt_count, delivered_at, create_time, update_time from merchant_crm_broadcast_recipient where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update merchant_crm_broadcast_recipient set status = 'DELIVERED', message_receipt_id = #{messageReceiptId}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, delivered_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{recipientId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_broadcast_recipient set status = #{status}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{recipientId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_broadcast set status = #{status}, audience_count = #{audienceCount}, consented_count = #{consentedCount}, no_consent_count = #{noConsentCount}, frequency_skipped_count = #{frequencySkippedCount}, delivered_count = #{deliveredCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'SENDING'
